synthesizedFacts.fact: Microcurrent devices should not be used with oil-based serums as they interfere with conductivity.
Certain forms of Vitamin C, like L-ascorbic acid, may oxidize quickly and cause irritation when used with microcurrent devices.
Stabilized Vitamin C derivatives such as sodium ascorbyl phosphate are safer alternatives for use with microcurrent devices.
